high_level_description: The image depicts a scene at a fried chicken restaurant in Seoul, South Korea, on October 30, 2025. The setting appears to be casual and social, with a group of people gathered around a table, some holding drinks and engaging in conversation. In the foreground, a person is holding up a two-dollar bill with an autograph of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang. The autograph is written in gold ink on a white paper bag that reads "SKIN ACTUALLY." This suggests that Jensen Huang may have been present at the event or was recently there, and someone has obtained his signature as a memento.
